name: Level 10 Scourgebane deals its level-scaled tooltip damage (#305)
contract: Scourgebane 92111 (Level 10 Passive): 'Direct damage dealt now has a $520007h% chance to strike an enemy with Scourgebane, dealing an additional $801832s2% Weapon damage plus ${$801832m1*$<scalingbp>+$SP*.25+$AP*.25} Holyflame Damage.' 801832 carries m1 = 262 (BasePoints 261, DieSides 1) and s2 = 50; its SpellDescriptionVariableID 182 defines $scalingbp = 0.0267291844060354 + 0.0048541098014737*PL + 0.0001859597762293*PL^2, 0.0939 at level 10, so the flat part is 24.6, not 262. A level 10 Templar with 30-150 attack power, no spell power and the 8-13 damage, 2.5 sec Walking Stick expects 24.6 + AP/4 + (8..13 + AP/14*2.5)/2 per non-critical hit, 38-82 before percentage modifiers; the unscaled base would put every hit above 262.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The target keeps the Templar's level
Attack power lies in the contract's range
About 70 auto attacks at a 20% trigger chance
A non-critical Scourgebane averages the level 10 tooltip amount
